comparator.heading: Comparator
comparator.intro: Compare insurance products across Awesome Insurance and its competitors. Select a product type, then pick between 2 and 4 products to compare.

comparator.noProductsForType: No products available for this type.
comparator.comparingHint: This takes 10–20 seconds while the assistant reads each product document.
comparator.maxProducts: You can compare at most {{max}} products.
comparator.staleNotice: Some source data may be out of date — verify before sharing with a customer.

brochure.title: Add a competitor brochure (optional)

brochure.noRoom: Untick a product to make room (you can compare up to 4).

pricing.scaledNote: Amounts are for {{amount}} of cover and scale with the sum chosen.

transcript.expires: Expires automatically, roughly 24 to 48 hours after it was last saved ({{time}}). While a session is open it is saved about every 30 seconds.
transcript.empty: Nothing has been saved in this session yet.

application.expires: Demo data: deleted automatically about 2 to 3 days after it was saved.

voice.heading: Voice Chat
voice.selectCustomer: Select a customer to start a voice conversation.
voice.emptyConnected: Type a message below, or press Start voice chat to speak. Clear resets the conversation.
voice.hintVoice: Voice chat is active — the assistant will respond with voice and text. Press Pause voice chat to type only.

consent.question: Before recording: has {{name}} agreed to this conversation being transcribed, and to key points from it being kept in memory for later conversations?
consent.hint: Nothing is saved or remembered, and no forms are filled, until you confirm. Use the buttons to answer; the assistant cannot answer for you.
consent.changed: The customer changed, so consent is needed again.
consent.confirmed: Consent confirmed at {{time}}. This conversation is transcribed and kept for about a day. Key points may stay in the customer's memory for 90 days or longer.
consent.declinedMessage: Consent declined. The session has ended and nothing was saved.

voice.pausedNotice: Voice chat paused: your microphone is off and the assistant's voice is silent. Typing still works, with text replies. The session ends after about 5 minutes without speech or typing.
voice.pausedExpired: The 5-minute limit has passed, so the session may have ended. Resume starts a new one if needed, and the recording consent question is asked again.
voice.sessionRestarted: The previous session ended while paused, so a new one was started. You will be asked for recording consent again.
voice.sessionRenewed: Your sign-in expired, so the voice session was ended and a new one was opened with a fresh sign-in. You will be asked for recording consent again, and the microphone is off until you start it.
voice.sessionExpired: Your sign-in has expired and the voice session has ended. Sign out and sign in again to continue.

recommendation.loading: Analyzing coverage and looking for gaps...
recommendation.noGaps: No material coverage gaps identified — the customer is well covered for their profile.

pdf.requiredNote: * Required. Leave any line blank that has not been answered yet and complete it by hand.
pdf.disclaimer: Draft prepared with the Awesome Insurance advisor assistant. This is not an offer of cover. Cover starts only when Awesome Insurance issues a policy after underwriting.
pdf.nlgAcknowledgment: NO-LAPSE GUARANTEE ACKNOWLEDGMENT: This policy has a no-lapse guarantee. The death benefit is guaranteed to the age shown on this application only if the required premium is paid on time. Paying only the minimum, or paying late, can reduce or permanently end the guarantee even if there is cash value. By signing, the applicant confirms receiving an illustration that shows the required premium.

form.secretNote: Typed here only. The assistants cannot see this field.

form.fillDemoHint: Demo only: fills the empty fields with the same sample answers for every customer. Fields that are already filled are kept.
form.demoNothing: Nothing to fill: every field already has an answer.
